data.name: Beaufert
data.gender_notes: Beaufert is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Germanic elements 'beau' meaning beautiful and 'fert' meaning warrior. This name was given to strong and handsome boys who were destined to lead their people into battle. The name Beaufert carries the meaning “Handsome warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Beaufert usually hope their child will grow to embody handsome warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Emblem of courage and strength in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Beaufert belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Handsome warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Beaufert total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_english.name: Beaufert
in_english.long_meaning: From the Old French 'beau' (beautiful, brave) and 'fer' (strong, bearer)

data.cultural_impact: The name Beaufert may have originated from European descent, but it carries a powerful and inspiring meaning. The name has a rich history, rooted in the Germanic culture, where strength, courage, and beauty were highly valued qualities, particularly for men. These qualities would have been valued not only in battle but also within society. The name Beaufert is the embodiment of a strong and fearless leader, inspiring a sense of pride and courage in those who bear it.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Beaufert holds a deeper spiritual significance beyond its cultural roots. As the meaning suggests, it represents a beautiful warrior, a sacred guardian, and a divine protector. The name highlights the duality of human nature, the inherent strength and the eternal beauty within all of us. It serves as a reminder that we each have the capacity to stand tall in the face of adversity and to shine bright amidst the darkness. The spiritual essence of the name Beaufert encourages us to embrace our inner strength, to cultivate our courage, and to embody the divine qualities of beauty, grace, and power.
